verdict.rationale: Adyen documents tokenizing shopper payment credentials so the agent passes a token rather than a raw card number (docs-3, docs-6). The UCP token is bound to a specific checkout session and merchant identifier (docs-7), which covers merchant and session scoping. There is no evidence of agent-configurable amount limits or expiry. Missing for 10: documented amount/spend limits on tokens, explicit expiry/limited-use controls, independent or hands-on corroboration.
